acceptance: Results identify the component under test and do not market managed or unrelated scores as Membrane scores.
observed: Every code path that can produce a memory-benchmark result — the existing LoCoMo/LongMemEval/BEAM adapters (benchmarks/memory/adapters.mjs), the contract they build on (benchmarks/memory/contracts.mjs, componentUnderTest fixed to 'crypt-memory'), the verifier (scripts/qualification/verify-memory-benchmark.mjs), and the new run harness added by this task (benchmarks/memory/runner.mjs, scripts/qualification/memory/run-memory-benchmarks.mjs) — labels its result with componentUnderTest: 'crypt-memory' and rejects any membraneScore/managedScore/attribution/marketingClaim field before a result can be reported as passed/ran. runner.test.mjs demonstrates this end to end for the new harness: a status of 'ran' is only reached when a caller-supplied executor payload passes that same verifier, and an executor payload carrying membraneScore is rejected with status 'invalid' and reason 'Membrane or managed score attribution is forbidden' rather than being reported as a passing or Membrane-branded result. Absent a configured dataset root or executor, the harness reports an explicit 'degraded' result (with a specific reason: dataset-root-not-configured, dataset-not-found, or executor-not-configured) instead of fabricating a score; no dataset is downloaded and no network call is made anywhere in the adapters, verifier, or runner. Status is recorded as pending_book_gate, not pass, per the book-mode execution rules: acceptance is finalized only at the Wave 4 phased gate (Gate phase 3.2) after node scripts/qualification/run.mjs --task MBR-805 is run there.
